scope: Two goals in Settings on one local iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26). Not a general phone-agent evaluation.
timing: From the first observation through the final DONE, including Jev requests, device verbs, re-observations and per-step screenshots. Excludes simulator boot and the example's own setup/verification walks.
jev: typesafe-ai/jev via the Vercel AI Gateway (free tier)

runs.goal: In Settings, open Accessibility, then Display & Text Size, and turn on Bold Text.
runs.start: Settings root screen (relaunched); the switch forced OFF first
runs.verified_by: examples/bold-text.ts walks to the switch with plain verbs after the run and reads its value

runs.goal: Open Settings and go to General, then About
runs.start: Settings on Display & Text Size, left there by the previous run
runs.verified_by: the final screenshot (docs/runs/about-local/004.png) shows the About screen
runs.media: demo.gif is this run's per-step screenshots at the recorded step timings

retained_failures.note: Reported done in 2 decisions and verified, but the run had started ON the target screen: the example's goHome() had not taken effect before the first observation. The example now relaunches Settings to its root and waits; the number was discarded.

retained_failures.goal: Bold Text on a phone-use cloud phone
retained_failures.note: The first RPC timed out (daemon under load from a concurrent benchmark). Cloud calls now go through resilient(): re-open on SESSION_NOT_FOUND, one retry for read-only calls, never for mutations.
